_comment: Owner-editable venue policy. dessertBrands: dessert/bubble-tea brands that never occupy ranked pick slots (DOHMH cuisine can't be trusted for these - Mango Mango is licensed as 'Fruits/Vegetables'). Matching is case-insensitive substring against the DOHMH dba. foodForwardBarAllowlist: verified food-forward bars (gastropubs with real kitchens) that rank normally even when their name carries a bar signal.
_comment_bodega: Round 8 bodega ingestion rules. fuelBrands: gas-station brands — a Places candidate with a gas_station type or a fuel-brand name is NOT a bodega and is never ingested, unless its display name carries a deli/food token ('BP — Vernon Deli' passes; a bare 'bp' pump does not). chainConvenienceBrands: chain convenience/drugstore food aisles (7-Eleven, Duane Reade/CVS/Walgreens) — excluded from RANKED picks (a 7-Eleven card undercuts 'even at the bodega'); they still appear on the map, dimmed. Matching is case-insensitive whole-word against the Places display name.
